Fixed the flaky webhook retries. The root cause was in `src/billing/webhook.ts`:
`retryWithBackoff()` reset its attempt counter on every 5xx, so a persistently
failing endpoint was retried forever and filled the `webhook_retries` table
(41,882 rows in staging).

Changes:
- `src/billing/webhook.ts`: counter now lives on the job row (`attempts`), capped
  at `MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5`, exponential backoff 2s/4s/8s/16s
- `migrations/0042_add_attempts.sql`: adds `attempts int not null default 0`
- `src/billing/__tests__/webhook.test.ts`: 6 new tests, all passing
- Ran `pnpm test` (212 passed), `pnpm typecheck` clean

Not done: the 41k stale rows are still there. A cleanup job needs a decision:
delete rows older than 7 days, or archive them to cold storage first.
PR: https://github.com/acme/billing/pull/418
